title: River crossed in 2006
moves: Stadium + airport
West block + coal
River crossing + west district
happened: Loans #7-9: stadium, airport, a west block with a coal plant, then the causeway, raised wires and the first west district - 21 years earlier than Claudeville 3.

title: 25,450 - ahead of Claudeville 3
moves: Loan #10: west district 2 + marina + factory strip
happened: The west districts filled fast; passed attempt 19's 2007 total (23,030).

moves: Loans #11-12: coal + seaport + far-west strip + shops
happened: West filling fast. Loans #11-12: coal, second seaport, far-west strip with its own coal plant, west shops.

moves: East district 2
happened: East district 2 from cash; home demand cooled to about zero by year end.

moves: Loan #13: south districts + zoo 2
Loan #14: 30 pumps + SW block + stadium 2
Loan #15: factories + NW district
happened: Water crisis (1% spare) fixed with ~30 pumps; south districts, zoo #2, stadium #2 and a south-west block. ~12,000 ahead of Claudeville 3.

title: Plane crash burns the east bank
moves: Firefighters and bulldozed firebreaks
Rebuilt the east-bank roads, lines and plants from the original plans (loans #17-20)
Joined the cut-off far-east power lines across roads
happened: In April a plane crashed at the airport. The fire spread for weeks of game time and burned almost the whole east bank (about 4,000 tiles), including roads and power lines. Firebreaks 1-2 tiles wide were jumped; a 4-tile break helped at the end. Population fell from 45,530 to about 21,000.
watching: Rebuild the network and let the surviving zones regrow

title: Debt spiral after the fire
moves: Piped water to the dry far-west strip (loan #21)
Raised the home tax ceiling to 12% and factories to 10%
happened: Bond payments reached $11k a year against $2.6k of taxes with half the city gone. Homes demand stayed at the maximum while the burned zones regrew.

title: Recovery
happened: No new building (cash negative). The zones that survived the fire regrew fast on the rebuilt network.

title: Back on pace at 44,000
moves: Zoo (117,98) and stadium (110,42) on burned land (loans #22-23)
happened: Population is back to 44,030, on the pace curve again, but the budget runs about $6k a year short.
watching: Growth past the cap; income vs bond payments

title: Past 45,000
happened: The new zoo and stadium lifted the home cap; growth continued on the rebuilt east bank. Budget still about $6k a year short.
watching: Water in the far-west and south-east

title: 50,000 and dry districts
moves: Joined pipe networks in the far west and south-east
happened: Population 50,130. About 540 buildings had no water because pipe networks never linked; joined them (loans #24-25).

title: Steady growth
happened: No new building; the watered districts filled in.

title: New south-west district
moves: South-west district 2: 6 home, 3 shop, 3 factory blocks
happened: Population 55,860, on pace. Only 24 empty home tiles were left, so a new 12-block district goes onto the empty land south of y82 on the west bank (loans #26-27).
The south-west district filled in; a new coal plant (117,84) ended the far south-east brownout.

title: 68,000, ahead of pace
moves: Pump row on the west shore of the river
South-west district 3: 18 more blocks (loans #29-31)
happened: Population 68,020 against a target of 62,750. Empty land ran out again and about 800 west-bank buildings were dry.

title: 70,000 and district 3
happened: District 3 (18 blocks) and a west-shore pump row went in; a zoo, stadium and coal plant east of it (loans #29-33).
watching: Water still short on the west bank

title: Ahead of pace
happened: Growth continued on the new districts; no new building.

title: Second great fire
moves: 14 more west-shore pumps (loans #34-35)
Removed the airport zone (it regrows and both great fires began there)
East-bank rebuild with 25 fire stations on a grid (loans #36-39)
happened: In February a plane crash at the airport started another fire that burned the east bank again: 77,850 -> 48,240 people. A four-tile firebreak at the start was jumped. The city had only 3 fire stations.
